# Dima Laundry

> Dima Laundry LLC is a Dubai laundry and dry cleaning company operating since 2001. It runs 8 retail branches (open 10am to 10pm daily) and 3 processing centres in Al Quoz (open 24 hours), cleans every item in-house, and offers pickup and delivery across Dubai. Prices start at AED 14 for a shirt and AED 48 for a two piece suit. Phone 800 DIMA (3462). WhatsApp +971 50 639 8093. Commercial +971 56 998 4493. Email info@dimalaundry.com. Order support retail.support@dimalaundry.com.

Mobile app: iOS https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/dima-laundry-dry-cleaning/id6738209489 | Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cleancloudapp.dimalaundry

## Guides
- [How Much Does Laundry Cost in Dubai? 2026 Price Guide](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/how-much-does-laundry-cost-in-dubai): In Dubai, cleaning and pressing a shirt typically costs AED 14 to AED 20, a two piece suit AED 48 to AED 80, and an abaya or kandura AED 20 to AED 40. Pressing only starts at around AED 10 a shirt. These are Dima Laundry's published prices for October 2026, and they are the same at every branch.
- [Holiday Home Laundry in Dubai: A Host's Guide to Linen Turnovers](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/holiday-home-laundry-dubai): Dubai holiday home hosts usually keep three sets of linen and towels per bed, send used sets to a commercial laundry after each checkout, and have clean sets returned folded and bagged per unit. A laundry with scheduled pickups and per unit bagging, such as Dima Laundry, keeps turnovers on time without a laundry room.
- [How to Clean Carpets and Rugs Before Dubai's Winter Season](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/clean-carpets-before-winter-dubai): Dubai carpets should be professionally cleaned every 6 to 12 months because fine sand settles deep in the pile and wears the fibres. Autumn, before the cooler months when windows open and guests visit, is a good time. Professional rug cleaning at Dima Laundry starts at AED 30 per square metre.
- [How to Clean and Store a Wedding Dress in Dubai](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/wedding-dress-cleaning-dubai): Clean a wedding dress within a few weeks of the wedding, before invisible sugar and sweat marks oxidise and turn yellow. Then store it flat or loosely folded in acid free tissue, away from light and humidity. At Dima Laundry wedding gowns are inspected first and priced before cleaning, and evening dresses start at AED 100.
- [Dry Cleaning vs Washing: What Your Clothes Labels Actually Mean](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/dry-cleaning-vs-washing-care-labels): Care labels use five symbols: a tub for washing, a triangle for bleach, a square for drying, an iron for pressing and a circle for professional cleaning. A cross through any symbol means do not. A circle with a letter means the item should go to a professional cleaner, and "dry clean only" pieces should never go in a home washing machine.
- [Hotel Laundry Outsourcing in Dubai: Costs and What to Ask](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/hotel-laundry-outsourcing-dubai): Dubai hotels outsource laundry to avoid the cost of machines, space, utilities and staff for an in-house operation. Commercial laundries usually charge per kilo or per piece based on volume, with scheduled daily collections and monthly invoicing. Before signing, check capacity, turnaround, item counting and who cleans the items.
- [How to Clean Designer Handbags Without Damaging Them](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/how-to-clean-designer-handbags): Clean a designer handbag gently with a soft dry cloth after use, keep it stuffed and stored in its dust bag away from heat, and never use household wipes, alcohol or water on leather. For stains, colour wear or ink, use a professional. Handbag cleaning at Dima Laundry starts at AED 80.
- [Abaya Care Guide: Washing, Dry Cleaning and Pressing](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/abaya-care-guide): Plain crepe and nida abayas can be hand washed or machine washed on a gentle cold cycle inside out, then line dried in the shade. Abayas with embroidery, beads, crystals, lace or chiffon layers should be dry cleaned. Professional abaya cleaning and pressing at Dima Laundry starts at AED 20, or AED 30 for delicate abayas.
- [Kandura Laundry: How to Keep Kanduras White in Dubai's Heat](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/how-to-keep-kanduras-white): Kanduras stay white when they are washed after every wear, separately from colours, with collars and cuffs pre-treated, and dried out of direct sun. Sweat and deodorant left in the fabric oxidise and turn yellow. At Dima Laundry a cotton kandura is AED 20 to clean and press and a wool kandura AED 30.
- [Eid Laundry Rush: How to Book Pickup in Time](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/eid-laundry-booking-tips): Dubai laundries are busiest in the week before Eid, when kanduras, abayas, dresses and home linen all arrive at once. Book pickup five to seven days before Eid, send traditional wear first, and confirm the ready date when you book. If you leave it late, ask about express service.
- [Sneaker Cleaning in Dubai: What Works and What Ruins Shoes](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/sneaker-cleaning-dubai): Clean sneakers by hand with a soft brush, mild soap and cool water, using products made for the material, and let them air dry away from direct sun. Washing machines and hot dryers weaken glue, warp foam and crack leather. Professional sneaker cleaning at Dima Laundry is AED 100 a pair.
- [How Often Should You Wash Bed Linen and Towels in Dubai?](https://www.dimalaundry.com/blog/how-often-to-wash-bed-linen-and-towels): In Dubai's heat, wash bed sheets and pillow cases weekly, bath towels after three or four uses, and hand towels every two or three days. Duvets and pillows need a full clean two to four times a year. At Dima Laundry a bed sheet is AED 20 to clean and press, a duvet AED 60 and a bath towel AED 10.
